purpose: Add owner-registered notification template definitions, mutable drafts, immutable release activation history, rendered summary snapshots, content formats, and monotonic notification state versions.
lockImpact: Adds tables and nullable/defaulted columns. ALTER TABLE takes short metadata locks; existing notification rows are not rewritten with new business content.
dataImpact: Historical title and body snapshots remain unchanged. Existing bodies are interpreted as plain text and legacy summaries fall back to the existing body at the application boundary.
backfill: No content backfill. Existing state versions use the database default of 1.
recovery: Keep all added facts and columns during application rollback. Disable template administration and forward-fix; never delete releases, activations, or notification history.
forwardFix: Append a later globally numbered migration. Never rewrite this migration after application.
